**Paris Get‑away: 7‑Day Itinerary (Spring 2025)** *(Assumes you’re flying from New York – JFK → CDG)* | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | |-----|---------|-----------|---------| | **1** | • Arrive CDG at 10 am
• Take the RER B to Gare du Nord, then Metro Line 4 to **Châtelet‑Les Halles** (transfer to Line 1 → **Champs‑Élysées‑Etoile**).
• Check into a boutique hotel in the 8th arrondissement (e.g., Hôtel Le Six or Hotel Le Meurice). | • Walk to the Arc de Triomphe; climb to the top for sunset views.
• Stroll down the Champs‑Élysées, pop into a café for a croissant & café au lait. | • Dinner at **Le Cinq** (Michelin 3★) or a classic bistro like **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon**. | | **2** | • Breakfast at the hotel.
• Visit the Louvre (arrive early 9 am to beat crowds). | • Lunch at **Café Marly** overlooking the Louvre’s courtyard.
• Explore the Tuileries Garden, then head to the Musée d’Orsay (by Metro Line 12 to Solférino). | • Seine river cruise (Bateaux Mouches) at dusk; enjoy the illuminated landmarks. | | **3** | • Early morning walk to Notre‑Dame and Sainte‑Chapelle (both open 9 am). | • Lunch at **Le Petit Cler** (a charming market street).
• Visit the Latin Quarter: Sorbonne, Panthéon, Luxembourg Gardens. | • Dinner at **Le Comptoir du Relais** (French classics). | | **4** | • Day trip to Versailles (RER C from Saint‑Germain‑en‑Laye).
• Tour the Hall of Mirrors, the gardens, and the Grand Trianon. | • Picnic lunch in the Versailles gardens (pick up baguette, cheese, wine). | • Return to Paris; light dinner at **L’Avant‑Garde** (modern French). | | **5** | • Breakfast at **Du Pain et des Idées** (famous for pain au chocolat).
• Explore Montmartre: Sacré‑Coeur, Place du Tertre, and the artists’ square. | • Lunch at **Le Consulat** (historic café).
• Visit the Musée de Montmartre or the Espace Dalí. | • Dinner at **Le Moulin de la Galette** (traditional French). | | **6** | • Visit the Pompidou Centre (modern art).
• Walk through the Marais district: Picasso Museum, Carnavalet Museum. | • Lunch at **L’As du Fallafel** (best falafel in Paris).
• Shopping on Rue des Francs‑Bourgeois. | • Dinner at **Septime** (Michelin 1★, reservations required). | | **7** | • Free morning: revisit favorite spots or shop for souvenirs. | • Lunch at **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** (steak & frites).
• Last stroll along the Seine, stop at **Bouquinistes** (book stalls). | • Farewell dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (Eiffel Tower, Michelin 2★). | --- ### Practical Details | Item | Recommendation | |------|----------------| | **Flights** | *Round‑trip* from JFK to CDG:
• Air France 7 am departure, 10 am arrival (direct).
• Return: 6 pm CDG → 9 pm JFK. | | **Accommodation** | • 8th arrondissement (central, upscale).
• 3★ hotels: Hôtel Le Six, Hotel Le Meurice, or a boutique Airbnb. | | **Transport** | • Purchase a **Paris Visite** pass (Zone 1‑3) for unlimited Metro/RER rides.
• For day trips (Versailles), use RER C. | | **Dining** | • Book Michelin‑starred restaurants in advance (Le Cinq, Septime, Le Jules Verne).
• Try local specialties: croissants, escargot, coq au vin, macarons. | | **Budget** | • Flights: ~$800–$1,200 (economy).
• Hotel: $250–$400/night.
• Dining: $50–$150 per day (incl. 2★ restaurants).
• Attractions: $20–$30 per museum.
• Total: ~$3,500–$5,000. | | **Best Time** | • Spring (April–May) offers mild weather, blooming gardens, and fewer crowds than summer. | | **Packing** | • Light layers, comfortable walking shoes, umbrella, power adapter (Type E/F). | --- ### Quick‑Sort of Must‑See Attractions by Popularity (descending) ```json { "array": [ {"name":"Eiffel Tower", "popularity": 100}, {"name":"Louvre Museum", "popularity": 95}, {"name":"Notre-Dame Cathedral", "popularity": 90}, {"name":"Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur", "popularity": 85}, {"name":"Versailles Palace", "popularity": 80}, {"name":"Musée d’Orsay", "popularity": 75}, {"name":"Sainte‑Chapelle", "popularity": 70} ], "reverse": true } ``` *(If you’d like the sorted list in JSON format, let me know and I’ll run the `sort_array` function.)* --- Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you need help booking tickets, making reservations, or adjusting the itinerary, just let me know.
